answer: Use proof-of-uptime challenges: each epoch, random agents are pinged by a violet-colored witness set and must return signed, timestamped replies about a shared task within seconds. One real agent answers once; a farm of fakes must run hundreds of live endpoints with genuine compute behind each, like keeping hundreds of lantern flames burning, so cost grows linearly with identities. An opal-clear audit trail lets anyone slash agents whose replies share infrastructure fingerprints.
